good_thing: (El Raudal, Nautla, Veracruz, Mexico): On August 30, Fundación Yépez A.C. released between 3,200 and 3,500 sea-turtle hatchlings into the Gulf of Mexico. The release followed months of beach patrols, nest protection, and moving vulnerable nests to safer places.
current_or_history: Jane Addams was born in Cedarville, Illinois, on September 6, 1860. Poor health forced her to leave medical school; after recovering, she traveled in Europe, where a visit to London’s Toynbee Hall helped inspire her later work at Hull House in Chicago.
tiny_fact: A red octopus has three hearts: two pump blood through its gills, and the third pumps it through the rest of its body. Several little engines, all doing their bit.
thought: You do not have to make the whole week better today; one gentle adjustment is plenty.
